reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutacion Sleeping Pack 100 ml Set (+Silicon Brush)
reviews.text: super cool mask. It is useful to dull complexion, if you use it for a long time
reviews.zh: 超正嘅 mask。如果長期使用，對於改善暗沉膚色有幫助。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutacion Sleeping Pack 100 ml Set (+Silicon Brush)
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this sleeping pack!! A little goes a long way, and as it goes on you can feel the little moisturizing beads bursting and releasing gentle hydration immediately. Spread it thinly, let it sink in (which doesn’t take super long) and then go to bed. In the morning, rinse off with lukewarm or cool water, and wake up to brightened, moisturized, smooth and soft skin. This helps me look like I got eight hours of beauty sleep, even on the nights when my insomnia makes it more like four hours 😅 One of the best products in my skincare collection; and one of those rare products that gives visible results the first time you use it. And the smell is lemony and DELICIOUS 🧡
reviews.zh: 我對呢個 sleeping pack 真係點讚都唔夠！！只需要少量已經好夠用，塗上去嘅時候可以感覺到一粒粒嘅保濕珠爆開，即時釋出溫和嘅水分。薄薄塗一層，等佢吸收（其實唔使好耐），就可以瞓覺。早上用凍水或者暖水沖洗，醒嚟皮膚就變得亮澤、保濕、嫩滑。佢令我睇落好似瞓咗八個鐘嘅美容覺，就算我失眠嗰啲夜晚實際只瞓到四個鐘 😅 係我護膚收藏入面最出色嘅產品之一；亦都係少數第一次用就即刻見到明顯效果嘅產品。聞落有檸檬味，好味到爆 🧡

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutacion Sleeping Pack 100 ml Set (+Silicon Brush)
reviews.text: ラッピングマスクだと思ったら違うのね笑普通に塗って寝るだけ。起きたら塗ってたか分からなかった。別に剥がすとかではないから普通にそのまま洗顔してます。
reviews.zh: 本來以為係撕拉式 mask，原來唔係笑死。普通咁塗上面瞓覺就得了。起咗身都唔記得自己塗過。唔係話要撕走嘅嘢，所以我就咁正常咁洗面。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutacion Sleeping Pack 100 ml Set (+Silicon Brush)
reviews.text: Feel very refreshing when applying it. The sleeping mask is easy to apply on, next morning my skin feels very soft n hydrated.
reviews.zh: 塗上去嘅時候感覺好清爽。Sleeping mask 好容易塗，翌日朝早皮膚感覺好柔軟又保濕。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutacion Sleeping Pack 100 ml Set (+Silicon Brush)
reviews.text: Deja muy glowy la cara, huele a limón pero el olor no es tan invasivo y se va a los minutos, no me irritó ni saco brotes
reviews.zh: 用完塊面好有水光感，有檸檬味但係味道唔算好濃，幾分鐘就散，冇刺激到我，又冇爆瘡。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutacion Sleeping Pack 100 ml Set (+Silicon Brush)
reviews.text: This is a light and easy apply sleeping pack, not too sticky, i do feel refreshed and evenout skintone a little. Hope to see better results if continue to use. I only use once 1 week
reviews.zh: 呢個 sleeping pack 質感輕身又好塗，唔會太黏笠，確實令我感覺煥然一新，膚色都均勻咗少少。希望繼續用會見到更好嘅效果。我一個星期只係用一次。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutacion Sleeping Pack 100 ml Set (+Silicon Brush)
reviews.text: This is not very friendly to sensitive skin. It gives me irritation and I haven’t see any immediate effect on my skin.
reviews.zh: 對敏感肌嚟講唔算友善。用完之後皮膚受到刺激，亦冇見到任何即時效果。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutacion Sleeping Pack 100 ml Set (+Silicon Brush)
reviews.text:
I like Super Lemon line from BRINGGREEN.
It's effective and comfortable.
Please, make body lotion and hand cream with fresh lemon scent.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意 BRINGGREEN 嘅 Super Lemon 系列。有效又好用。麻煩品牌出多啲清新檸檬味嘅 body lotion 同 hand cream。
